# Waivers for scripts/check-workflow-standard.sh -- "<path> <RULE>  # reason".
# Every line here is debt against docs/WORKFLOW-STANDARD.md. Remove the line in
# the PR that fixes it; never add one to get a new workflow past the gate.

# Deploy workflows were left untouched by the workflow-standard PR on purpose:
# a timeout on a production deploy needs a value agreed with the service owner
# (canary observation alone defaults to 10 minutes), and re-pinning deploy
# actions should ship on its own so a rollback is unambiguous.
.github/workflows/reusable-deploy-gcp.yml timeout
.github/workflows/reusable-deploy-gcp.yml pin
.github/workflows/reusable-deploy-vercel.yml timeout
.github/workflows/reusable-deploy-vercel.yml permissions
.github/workflows/reusable-deploy-vercel.yml pin

# pip-audit installs whatever manifest the caller has; setup-python's pip cache
# fails the job when no requirements*.txt / pyproject.toml exists.
.github/workflows/reusable-security.yml cache
